items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Paul Howard was instrumental in getting me into it... he explained all the benefits... he just took the time to explain all of the advantages of being a union person to me.

ctx.x: And then, when the union did -- as I
say, Paul was just always the -- he was the one person there that seemed to have drawn everybody into the union, you know, and he just made you conscious of the union and the benefits, you know.
